site.name: INTERACT RECORD
site.description: The stage for African artists: discover, support and book Cameroon’s finest talent.

home.title: Africa’s talent, closer than ever.
home.subtitle: Discover artists from Cameroon, support them directly and book them for your events.
home.emptyBody: The first artists are on their way. Come back soon.
home.unavailableBody: Check your connection and try again.

artist.noBio: This artist hasn’t written a bio yet.

booking.notBookable: This artist isn’t taking bookings right now.

share.title: Share
share.hint: Print it on your posters and flyers.

notFound.title: This page doesn’t exist
notFound.body: The artist may have changed their name, or the link is incomplete.

error.title: Something went wrong

login.title: Team space
login.subtitle: Sign in with your account’s phone number. Only team members have access.

home.noToolsTitle: No tools for your role yet
home.noToolsBody: Finance and editorial screens arrive in the next steps.

forbidden.title: Restricted access
forbidden.body: Your role can’t open this page. Ask an administrator if you need it.

admin.offline: You’re offline. Pages already open stay readable; actions resume when the network is back.

common.reasonHint: 5 to 500 characters. It is recorded in the audit log.
common.errorBody: Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, tell the tech team.

users.title: Accounts
users.subtitle: Search by exact phone number or by name. Numbers are masked in the list.
users.emptyBody: Check the number, or try part of the name.
users.viewNotice: Your viewing of this record is written to the audit log.

suspension.suspendBody: Suspension immediately closes all their sessions. They won’t be able to sign in.
suspension.reactivateBody: The person can sign in again. A pending deletion request is kept.

roles.title: Team roles
roles.body: Fan and artist roles aren’t changed here.

artists.title: Artists
artists.subtitle: Find an artist to grant or remove the “verified artist” badge.
artists.emptyBody: Try another spelling of the stage name.
artists.verifyBody: Grant it only after checking the artist’s identity.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every sensitive action, newest first. Nothing in it can be changed.

errors.PHONE_INVALID: This number isn’t valid. Check it and try again.
errors.OTP_INVALID: Wrong code. Check the 6 digits you received by SMS.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Ask for a new code.
errors.OTP_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many code requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.ADMIN_ACCESS_DENIED: This account isn’t part of the team. Access to the back office is denied.
errors.AUTH_FORBIDDEN: Your role doesn’t allow this action.
errors.ADMIN_CANNOT_SUSPEND_SELF: You can’t suspend your own account.
errors.ADMIN_CANNOT_SUSPEND_STAFF: Only an administrator can suspend a team member.
errors.ADMIN_CANNOT_REACTIVATE_STAFF: Only an administrator can reactivate a team member.
errors.ADMIN_SUSPENSION_LOCKED: An administrator decided this suspension: only an administrator can lift it.
errors.ADMIN_CANNOT_REMOVE_OWN_ADMIN: You can’t remove your own administrator role.
errors.ARTIST_VERIFY_OWN_PROFILE: You can’t verify a profile you are a member of.
errors.REASON_TOO_SHORT: Write a reason of 5 to 500 characters.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.CURSOR_INVALID: This results page no longer exists. Go back to the start.
errors.API_UNAVAILABLE: The service isn’t responding. Check your connection and try again.
errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
